list.name: zone
list.query: SELECT city FROM gold.dim_delivery_zone WHERE is_active ORDER BY city

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM gold.fact_purchase_orders f JOIN silver.purchase_orders_current po ON po.purchase_order_id = f.purchase_order_id WHERE f.status = 'in-transit' AND po.target_delivery_date < now()

SELECT f.purchase_order_id, f.truck_id, dz.city AS zone_city, po.target_delivery_date, now() - po.target_delivery_date AS overdue_by FROM gold.fact_purchase_orders f JOIN silver.purchase_orders_current po ON po.purchase_order_id = f.purchase_order_id LEFT JOIN gold.dim_delivery_zone dz ON dz.zone_id = f.zone_id WHERE f.status = 'in-transit' AND po.target_delivery_date < now() AND dz.city IN (${zone:sqlstring}) ORDER BY overdue_by DESC

SELECT dz.city, date_trunc('day', d.date) AS time, count(*) AS orders FROM gold.fact_purchase_orders f JOIN gold.dim_datetime d ON d.date_key = f.order_date_key JOIN gold.dim_delivery_zone dz ON dz.zone_id = f.zone_id WHERE d.date > current_date - interval '14 days' AND dz.city IN (${zone:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT dz.city, avg(fdp.delay_days) AS avg_delay_days, count(*) AS delivered_orders FROM gold.fact_delivery_performance fdp JOIN gold.dim_delivery_zone dz ON dz.zone_id = fdp.zone_id WHERE fdp.delivery_time > now() - interval '14 days' AND dz.city IN (${zone:sqlstring}) GROUP BY dz.city ORDER BY avg_delay_days DESC

SELECT dc.name, count(*) AS delivered_orders, round(100.0*avg(CASE WHEN NOT fdp.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),1) AS pct_late, avg(fdp.delay_days) AS avg_delay_days FROM gold.fact_delivery_performance fdp JOIN gold.dim_customer dc ON dc.customer_key = fdp.customer_key AND dc.dbt_valid_to IS NULL GROUP BY dc.name HAVING count(*) >= 3 ORDER BY pct_late DESC LIMIT 20
